mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_knowledge (title, keywords, content, enabled, sort_order) VALUES (#{title}, #{keywords}, #{content}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_knowledge SET title = #{title}, keywords = #{keywords}, content = #{content}, enabled = #{enabled}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: UPDATE t_ai_knowledge SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ai_knowledge WHERE deleted = 0 AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT * FROM t_ai_knowledge WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT * FROM t_ai_knowledge WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id}
